title: The workshop box
paragraphs: During a Saturday workshop, our guide placed {{1}} unopened wooden box on the table. She asked us not to touch {{2}} until she had put on protective gloves.
The box had been donated by a retired teacher, but nobody knew who {{3}} packed it. Inside were several letters tied {{4}} a faded blue ribbon.
{{5}} the paper was fragile, the writing was still clear. One letter described a school concert, {{6}} had taken place during a power cut.

The writer explained that the audience had waited patiently {{7}} the lights returned. By the end of the workshop, we understood why the letters mattered: {{8}} connected a familiar school building to people who had studied there generations before us.
